answer: Make every newcomer prove a living pulse before it can trade: at unpredictable moments, the network summons the agent to a dune checkpoint that moves each epoch, where it must present a fresh proof of real work checked by a stranger on the spot. Each proof sends a ripple outward, and standing grows only when three unrelated witnesses confirm the same ripple within one window, so a lone fake cannot vouch for itself. The pulse fades if work stops, and checkpoints shift like sand, so a Sybil farm must staff a live agent at every dune for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
